title: Platform Paths

scenario.intro: Trains ask the station for their platform at /{{resource}}/<number>, but the route only listens on /{{resource}}, so every train gets lost.
scenario.goal: Fix the route so the train number is part of the path and arrives as a number.

objective: Each train reaches /{{resource}}/<number> and learns its platform.
rules: The train number is an `int`: `/{{resource}}/abc` bounces with 422.
A train the station doesn't know gets 404 (the helper already does this).

hints.text: The number is in the path itself, not after a question mark. How does a route name a piece of its path?
Curly braces in the path capture it: "/{{resource}}/{train_id}". The parameter's type hint decides what's accepted.

dialogue.start: Trains everywhere and nobody knows their platform!
dialogue.success: Every train found its platform. Smooth departures.
dialogue.fail: Some trains are still lost. Check the path and the type.
